assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
Diagnosis code G45.9 corresponds to the symptoms described
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Diagnosis code I49.9 corresponds to unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered
The CPT code for the service is 93229
The monitoring is intended to capture real-time electrocardiographic data during symptom onset
The service is medically necessary to correlate episodic symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances
